submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repaint Image 1 as one opaque native 1254x1254 square game-map detail, with exactly the same camera, crop, paving scale and geometry. It is a CLOSE DETAIL OF EMPTY STONE PAVING ONLY. NO PLANTER, NO FOLIAGE, NO LANTERN, NO RAILING, NO BUILDING, NO OBJECTS, NO TEXT. The image contains only smooth light gray inset stone sectors, warm ivory broad curved stone borders and ivory paving joints. Retain all visible arcs and joint endpoints in their current positions. The leftmost 230px is the actual shared neighboring stone image: preserve it exactly. The apparent vertical line at x=230 is a guide paste boundary: remove this false vertical edge in the redrawn interior and smoothly extend the stones and ivory bands rightward from the exact edge-strip endpoints, with no vertical ledge, stripe or division. Keep the curved bands where Image 1 shows them, and merge only the guide discrepancy. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp rounded stone bevels and fine clean seams without increasing the mapped scale or introducing new structure. Image 2 supplies ONLY the user-approved hand-painted material quality, bright clean restrained shading and rounded Daoist chibi aesthetic. Never copy its flowers, ornaments, UI, objects or text. Stone is quiet and clean with subtle hand-painted variation, no gritty speckles, cracks, glossy plastic, blur or oversharpening. Return only this close crop of empty paving, full bleed, no border; maximum available fidelity.
